title: onprem/airgap: offline bundle vendoring + rke2/flatcar rollback tooling
author: Diego Patel
description: Motivation: customers running private/offline installs on RKE2 + Flatcar reported rollback gaps when a bundle upgrade partially applied; this PR improves offline bundling/vendoring so rollbacks are atomic and adds tooling to generate a rollback artifact. Changes: - Offline bundle generator: include per-component versioned manifest and deterministic tar manifest to enable verification and rollback. - Vendoring: add vendoring support for rke2 and container runtimes into the offline bundle (pre-pulled images + sha256 metadata). - TUF metadata: extend metadata generation to include rollback targets and staged-metadata support for safe rollbacks. - Helm charts: small adjustments to private-installer chart values to support staged upgrades and rollback hooks. - Rollback tooling: new CLI subcommand (installer rollback create/verify/apply) to produce and validate rollback artifacts in air-gapped environments. - Tests: add e2e/offline-bundle rollback scenario and unit tests for vendoring. Backwards compatibility: existing offline bundles remain supported; new rollback metadata is optional. Checklist: - [x] Add per-component manifests and vendored assets - [x] Update TUF metadata generation - [x] Add rollback CLI + docs - [x] Add e2e test scenario - [x] Update Helm values and chart templates - [x] Run CI and fix flakes Related: ENG-7421 (rollback reliability), SUP-4312 (customer report), ENG-7508 (bundle vendoring). Release notes: offline bundles now include optional rollback artifacts and improved vendoring for RKE2/Flatcar installs. Testing notes: initial CI failed on e2e due to timing in the staged-metadata apply, addressed by adding a small backoff and retry in the installer apply logic. See commit summaries and review comments for details.
commit_summary: a1b2c3d: offline-bundle: emit component-manifests and deterministic archive manifest
d4e5f6a: vendoring: add rke2 flatcar image prefetcher and sha256 manifests
b7c8d9e: tuf: include rollback targets and staged-metadata generation
f0e1d2c: helm: support staged-upgrade and rollback hooks in private-installer chart
c3b4a5f: cli: add rollback create/verify/apply subcommands
9a8b7c6: tests: add e2e/offline-bundle rollback scenario and unit tests
review_comments: Ava Morgan: Nice end-to-end here. Two high-level asks: 1) ensure offline bundle size implications are documented and 2) can we make staged-metadata retries configurable?
Diego Patel: Responded: documented bundle size and added --staged-retry and env var INSTALLER_STAGED_RETRY (default 5 attempts, 2s backoff).
Lina Chen: Found a race in staged metadata apply in e2e; suggested adding a deterministic sleep and retry — implemented as exponential backoff with jitter. Verified locally against flatcar VM.
Marco Ruiz: Approved after CI green and small comment about improving log lines for revert path (left a TODO and a follow-up ticket ENG-7586).
CI: e2e job failed on first run (staged-metadata ordering). Reran after backoff fix, all checks passed.
release_notes: Offline bundles: optional rollback artifacts and vendoring for RKE2/Flatcar. Includes new CLI rollback create/verify/apply and Helm chart support for staged upgrades. Backwards compatible.
